description: This file contains utility functions for constructing form data with dashboard context in Apache Superset, including merging filters, handling duplicates, and applying time ranges for visualization configuration.

methods.name: removeExtraFieldForNewCharts
methods.description: Adjusts the 'isExtra' property of filters based on whether the chart is new.

methods.name: removeAdhocFilterDuplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate adhoc filters based on specific properties to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: mergeFilterBoxToFormData
methods.description: Merges filter box data from dashboard into form data, handling time range filters.

methods.name: mergeNativeFiltersToFormData
methods.description: Merges native filters from dashboard into form data, including extra form data and filters.

methods.name: applyTimeRangeFilters
methods.description: Applies time range filters to adhoc filters if specified in dashboard form data.

methods.name: getFormDataWithDashboardContext
methods.description: Main exported function that constructs form data incorporating dashboard context, filters, and visualization settings.
